CPP_RANGE_UNIQUE_MSG0: Squeeze out adjacent duplicates in %1 through %2 and give the new end
CPP_RANGE_UNIQUE_TOOLTIP: Only adjacent duplicates are squeezed out, so the range usually needs to be sorted first. It does not shorten the container: the tail is still there but no longer meaningful. To actually shorten it, hand the returned position to the erase block.
